summary: QV.13.055 analysis notebook for Drelvessa Therapeutics SAS (DT-6 virtual library). It records how the library was prepared and docked, the protonation-state review that changed the hit ranking, and the consensus list Drelvessa ordered from. Scores are interpreted in the readout (D-002); this notebook keeps the provenance and the limits on what the docking can support.
